publication: Heliana’s Guide to Monster Hunting (first printing)
author: Max Wartelle, Mohamed Bellafquih, and Jesse Jackdaw Burns
heading: Mycelian Traits
sourceVersion: First edition, first printing, April 2023, ISBN 978-1-9990962-8-1
provenance: Player traits from chapter 6 of the April 2023 first printing of Heliana’s Guide to Monster Hunting, using the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: Fen uses a 2014 dwarf host for size, 25-ft. walk, darkvision and Dwarven Resilience. The host does not confer the rest of the dwarf traits.
The first printing’s optional GM latitude is not needed for the assigned build.

sourceDistinctions: Aster uses the Medium former elf and its +1 Intelligence option. The printed entry does not replace the usual Humanoid type.

sourceDistinctions: Rechecked the printed Cube and Puddle actions and the 2014 acid splash, which targets one creature or a close pair rather than a 5-ft. sphere.
